recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-20653 unless a future work-group decision explicitly revives the alternative comment that both input and output should share a Parameter class.
issue_request: FHIR-20653 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request asking that the Task UML representation align with the Task.input backbone element because the diagram showed Task.input as class Parameter while the reporter expected Input to match the backbone element name and the parallel Output class.
initial_application: The only Jira-keyed commit found for FHIR-20653 was ec83d5b5057f1402bdeb77453f5d214806de6b8c, an omnibus MnM R5 commit that mentioned the key but did not touch Task source. The substantive Task change was applied later under FHIR-30795 in commit 92e1da709709a486a40991f10ab62ca95c056619, which removed the explicit Parameter type-name override from Task.input.
additional_context: FHIR-30795 is a Published/Persuasive same-change-family issue for the same Task UML defect. Task is in current build scope through source/fhir.ini, current source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml leaves Task.input and Task.output as ordinary BackboneElement children without the old explicit Parameter type name, and current source/task/task.svg labels Task.input as Input and Task.output as Output. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community direction.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative Task source and current UML output already satisfy the requested alignment.
